faq.question: Can I book if I am not sure which service I need?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with the closest match to your goal and use the booking notes to share a reference or question. The consultation refines the plan before work begins.

faq.question: What should I share before a color appointment?
faq.answer: Include a recent photo in natural light, a few references, and any recent color history so the studio can plan the appointment responsibly.

faq.question: Can hair and skincare be planned together?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose the relevant services in booking and the studio can help plan the order and timing of a longer visit.

faq.question: When will I see the total?
faq.answer: The booking experience confirms the selected service and total before you finalize the appointment.
